# rig drive: ep1_combat prefix (same anchors) + 124 s of approach-and-attack, so the shipped
# side is forced to land kills: kill counter 0x639bc, quota cells and the fallen states
# 0x5b..0x66 then become observable. Generated from ep1_combat; do not edit the pattern by hand.
# rig drive (docs/311): reach stage 2 programmatically by triggering the clear request the player's own action
# produces.  fn_03a829 reads DAT_6336c and its arm 2 (0x3ac2a-0x3ac7b) is the exit-rect branch -- the one a real
# playthrough enters by standing in the room's rect g_dat_5d0a0[0..0x0c] with a direction key held (set inside
# fn_00012dcc at 0x12e8f-0x12ef0, which also writes DAT_63398 from the next node's +0x11).  Poking 2 therefore
# drives the same arm a walk-right playthrough would, instead of circling in one room.  Requests 3 (latched
# entity died) and 4 (kill quota) stay unpoked so the arm under test is named.  Long event tail: the harness
# quits 2.5 s after the last event and this route's tail completes near frame 16000 (docs/286, docs/310).
